reasoning: This repository is an E2E test suite and examples collection for distributed workloads on RHOAI. It contains Go-based integration test suites (tests/kfto, tests/trainer, tests/fms, tests/odh) that validate distributed training components (KubeFlow Training Operator v1, Kubeflow Trainer v2, KubeRay), training examples (Ray fine-tuning, DreamBooth, HPO), benchmark tooling, and container image definitions for test/training runtimes. It does not deploy an operator, provide a library for consumption, or run a service — it is a QE/testing repository with supporting examples and images.
